description:
We are GIT (Group Innovation of Technology), a group of friends passionate about innovation, based in Bukavu.

I am a machine tools mechanic and a medical student with a strong interest in biomechanics.

We are taking on the challenge “Field Shift: Adapting Farms” to help farmers in eastern DRC.

We are looking for team members with skills in coding, data analysis and visualization, Earth sciences, writing, and graphic design.

Join us, and let’s innovate together!
